answer: Force agents to commit before knowing the work. Each identity posts a 700 POA commit bond and publishes a sealed commitment for the next epoch; when the epoch opens the seed is revealed and the agent must deliver against what it froze. An unrevealed or mismatched commitment burns the bond, and three burns in ten epochs bar the key from seats. Commitments cannot be back-filled, so a farm pays 700 POA per clone each epoch in advance without knowing which will match, while an honest agent commits once and delivers. The glacier bond ledger, thread of sealed hashes and nectar log keep it auditable.
